panels.headline: From Dream to Doctor
panels.body: For every late night, long shift, and quiet sacrifice that brought you here.
panels.art_direction: Deep navy background, elegant font, soft gold accents, and a white-coat hero composition with a clean lower text-safe area.
panels.image_prompt: Full-bleed flat 2D artwork layer for the front of a premium vertical 5x7 print panel; choose one dominant hero visual or sparse line-art composition, keep a clean text-safe area, and avoid all-over motif wallpaper. Elegant medical-school graduation artwork inspired by premium stationery: deep navy and soft gold, either one cinematic white coat plus graduation cap and stethoscope hero composition, or a sparse ECG line with a small stethoscope/cap mark; interiors use an ivory note-sheet field, thin gold border, lower-edge ECG line, and one stethoscope corner object, never dense repeated medical icons. Artwork layer only, not a physical card or photographed paper. No inner card rectangle, no mockup frame, no table, no envelope, no label, no sign, no blank tag, no text box, no shadowed paper sheet. Decorative print borders are allowed. No people. No hands.
